sources.title: Arctic Long Sequence Training (ALST) for HF Transformers integration
sources.snippet: Ulysses Sequence Parallelism for Hugging Face (HF) Transformers implements an efficient way of training on long sequences by employing sequence parallelism and attention head parallelism. Arctic Long Sequence Training (ALST) enables even longer sequence lengths using a bag of tricks: Activation checkpoint offload to CPU Tiled MLP compute Liger-kernel PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF
